label: The node cost
subgoals: Add base cost and history cost
Compute the present cost from occupancy plus one minus capacity
Multiply the two to price the node

label: Negotiation between paths
subgoals: Sum node costs along each candidate path
Take the cheaper path even when it is congested
Let rising prices push flexible nets onto alternatives

label: Convergence and legality
subgoals: Sum the overuse over all nodes
Iterate while the total overuse is positive
Declare failure at the iteration limit
